integrity.first_public_date_basis: The Numdam/Comptes Rendus record lists Le Barz's article as published online on 2005-05-10.

scientific_limitations: The complex statement is restricted to general smooth complete intersections of two surfaces of degrees at least four in projective three-space.
The real consequence is restricted to the open locus where the four-secant scheme is zero-dimensional.
The theorem concerns the degree of the quadrisecant zero-cycle; it does not assert reducedness.
Special complete intersections involving quadrics or cubics are excluded because excess and higher-order multisecants occur.
title: A mod-8 parity law for quadrisecants of complete-intersection space curves
